# Vedantu

> > Vedantu is a comprehensive K1-K12 online education platform offering live classes, NCERT solutions, and competitive exam coaching for students across India.

Vedantu provides personalized 1-on-1 live online classes, NCERT study materials, and exam preparation resources for CBSE, JEE, NEET, and other competitive exams. The platform serves students from early childhood through Grade 12 with specialized programs in English, Math, and spoken communication skills.

## Key Topics

- NCERT Solutions
- CBSE Curriculum
- Live Classes
- Class 11 & 12
- Physics, Chemistry, Biology
- JEE & NEET Preparation
- Competitive Exams
- Online Tutoring
- Study Materials
- Board Exams
- Olympiad Preparation
- English Superstar
- Super Math
- Superspeakers
- K12 Education

## Core Offerings & Products

- [Vedantu: Premier K1 to K12 Online Classes and Offline Centers for Competitive Exams](https://www.vedantu.com): Vedantu homepage: K1-K12 online classes, JEE/NEET prep, and competitive exam coaching.
- [Vedantu English Superstar | Online Reading, Phonics Classes for Kids (LKG–8)](https://www.vedantu.com/english-superstar): English Superstar product: 1-on-1 phonics and reading classes for kids LKG-8.
- [Online Public Speaking Classes for Kids (LKG–8) | Vedantu Superspeakers](https://www.vedantu.com/superspeakers): Vedantu Superspeakers: Live spoken English and public speaking for kids LKG-8.
- [Online Math Classes for Kids (KG-8) | 1-on-1 LIVE| Vedantu Super Math](https://www.vedantu.com/supermath): Super Math product: 1-on-1 live math classes for KG-8 with Olympiad prep.

## NCERT Solutions & Study Materials

- [NCERT Solutions For CBSE Class 1 - 12](https://www.vedantu.com/ncert-solutions): Free NCERT solutions for CBSE Classes 1-12 with chapter-wise PDFs.
- [NCERT Solutions For Class 12 - All Subjects](https://www.vedantu.com/ncert-solutions/ncert-solutions-class-12): Class 12 NCERT solutions for all subjects with step-by-step explanations.
- [NCERT Solutions For Class 12 Physics](https://www.vedantu.com/ncert-solutions/ncert-solutions-class-12-physics): Class 12 Physics NCERT solutions with chapter-wise answers and PDFs.
- [NCERT Solutions For Class 12 Chemistry](https://www.vedantu.com/ncert-solutions/ncert-solutions-class-12-chemistry): Class 12 Chemistry NCERT solutions with detailed step-by-step explanations.
- [NCERT Solutions For Class 12 Biology](https://www.vedantu.com/ncert-solutions/ncert-solutions-class-12-biology): Class 12 Biology NCERT solutions with chapter-wise answers and PDFs.
- [NCERT Solutions For Class 12 Maths](https://www.vedantu.com/ncert-solutions/ncert-solutions-class-12-maths): Class 12 Maths NCERT solutions with step-by-step solutions and PDFs.
- [NCERT Solutions For Class 12 English 2025-26 |Chapter Wise PDF Answers](https://www.vedantu.com/ncert-solutions/ncert-solutions-class-12-english): Class 12 English NCERT solutions with chapter-wise PDFs for CBSE exams.
